producer_report.summary: Enabled skip_when_only = ["docs/", "*.md"] on the change capability's fmt and clippy checks in athena.toml. The test check has no skip key, and a comment above it explains why (xtask/tests/policy.rs reads docs/*.md and scans every tracked file). The study checks and all other keys are unchanged. CHANGELOG.md's first Unreleased bullet now says the key is set on fmt and clippy only, with the test check never skipping, and no longer calls enabling a pending follow-up. docs/enforcement.md row M31 states the current setting and names a new test. One change outside the listed deliverables was needed: the existing config test skip_when_only_is_optional_and_parsed_when_present asserted the repository config had no skip key, so it failed. I split it into two tests in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs: one asserts fmt and clippy carry the prose patterns and test carries none; the other keeps the parse-when-present check, now applied to the test check. All three checks pass.

checks_run.note: Run before and after the config.rs test edit; no output, so no formatting diff.
Run after the config.rs test edit; finished with no warnings.

First run failed one test (skip_when_only_is_optional_and_parsed_when_present) because it asserted the repository config had no skip key. After the test edit, all suites pass, including config::tests::default_configuration_loads, skip_when_only_is_set_on_fmt_and_clippy_only, every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists, and athena_refers_to_no_one_who_runs_it_or_where.

open_issues: crates/athena-data/src/config.rs is outside the expected deliverables. Athena should confirm that this test-only edit is acceptable for this job, or ask for a separate job.
The verifier judges only the candidate diff, so it will see the athena.toml change and the config.rs test change together. The boundary scan and enforcement-map test passed locally.
mistakes: I did not check the xtask boundary scan's behaviour on a prose-only change; I relied on the brief's claim that it scans every tracked .md file. The test suite passed, so no failure was seen, but I did not run a prose-only change through it.
I did not list crates/athena-data/src/config.rs in the brief's expected deliverables before editing it. The edit was needed to pass cargo test, but I should have flagged it before making it.
learnings: Only athena.toml and defaults.toml are included with include_str! in the Rust crates; no crate includes a .md file, so skipping fmt and clippy for prose is safe.
crates/athena-data/src/config.rs has a test that asserted the repository config had no skip_when_only key; it is the only test that pins the key's absence, and it ran under cargo test.
docs/enforcement.md row M31 named the test skip_when_only_is_optional_and_parsed_when_present; the enforcement-map check only requires named tests to exist, so adding a test name is safe.
The CHANGELOG Unreleased section has two Added headings and two Fixed headings from earlier jobs; I did not restructure them.
desires: A way to see which files the gate treats as governance, to confirm whether crates/athena-data/src/config.rs needs to be a listed deliverable for this job.
